component.name: LinuxPad++
component.summary: Source code editor, the native Linux edition of Notepad++

description.p: LinuxPad++ is Notepad++ with a native Qt interface for Linux: syntax highlighting, document tabs, split view, search and replace, macros and sessions.

More than 50 Notepad++ plugins are ported and bundled, among them ComparePlus, XML Tools, DSpellCheck, NppExec, Explorer, HEX-Editor, JSON Viewer and JSONTools. Choose the ones to load in Plugins Admin.
First release of LinuxPad++, the native Linux edition of Notepad++ 8.9.9.1, with 53 ported Notepad++ plugins, among them ComparePlus, XML Tools, DSpellCheck, NppExec, Explorer and HEX-Editor.
